scope: Union of available stage start/finish receipts, including process setup, evaluation, fitting, failed attempts and profiling. This is not GPU kernel time, not total reservation time and not total FLOPs. An interrupted attempt lacking a completion receipt may be absent; original queue logs and local provenance remain the detailed record. Operational PID and foreign-process information is not exported.

resource_release.scope: Verified owned controllers and reservation exited; no active study stage was interrupted. PID identity was checked before pidfd-based SIGTERM. Other users may acquire the GPU after release.

sampled_resource_accounting.scope: One GPU, cooperative admission lock plus held VRAM and reusable worker allocator cache; sampled every15seconds. Historical holder renewals use verified transition time ranges; worker matching uses recorded PIDs and is not continuous process-lifetime attestation. This is not administrator-enforced exclusive mode and cannot rule out activity between samples. Reservation memory is not algorithm memory usage.
